title: Grant a database
description: Role pgclient (authorization postgresql19c@any:pgclient). Create the database if missing, create or update the login role of the caller and return new credentials. Modules of the same application (image) may share a database. A module caller always acts for itself; client_id and share are for administrators. See docs/integration.md

share.description: Administrators only: give client_id access to an existing database created for another client
